Full summary: Drafted the memo send wrapper (docs/field-responses/2026-08-16-memo-send.md): retrieval steps for the field machine, cover note, paste-ready session prompt driving upgrade + retirements + the two D14/D15 verification questions + probe re-runs, and the expected response doc.
Decisions: Chose a committed send-wrapper doc over an ad-hoc message — it travels with the repo to the field machine via the same git pull that delivers the memo, and the session prompt pins the exact verification steps so the field lane cannot skip the archaeology. Assumption flagged in the doc: the field repo's memo directory is docs/twining/ — adjust on delivery.
Findings: The send defines a concrete return artifact (2026-08-16-wave2-verification.md) — if D15's predicted status post is absent with no housekeeping/unarchive/merge trace, D15 reopens as a genuine unknown and the field escalates with twining.db + mirror history
